lessons.title: Understanding Safe Enough Parenting
lessons.learningGoal: Understand what 'safe enough' means in child protection.
lessons.microLesson: Safe enough parenting means children are protected from harm, supervised, emotionally supported, and basic needs are consistently met.
lessons.activity: Write a short reflection: What does 'safe enough' look like in your home?
